Done. All 10 tests pass. Here's what was implemented:

- **`tokenize`** (`src/lexer.ts:9`): Splits template string into tokens — `text`, `value` (with `raw` flag for triple braces), `if`, `else`, and `end`. Handles `{{`/`{{{` opening, `}}`/`}}}` closing, and throws `"unterminated tag"` on unclosed braces.

- **`lookup`** (`src/lookup.ts:2`): Traverses dotted paths using `Object.hasOwn` (so only own properties are visible, blocking prototype pollution). Returns `undefined` for missing paths or when traversing into non-objects (primitives, null).

- **`isTruthy`** (`src/lookup.ts:13`): Standard JS truthy except empty arrays (`[]`) are false.

- **`render`** (`src/render.ts:36`): Orchestrates tokenization, if/else block nesting with a stack, filter pipeline (`upper`, `lower`, `default`), HTML escaping (unless raw/`{{{`), and error handling for unclosed/unexpected blocks and unknown filters.
